shortBulletSummary: The crypto market surged following a $1.44 billion short liquidation, briefly driving Bitcoin to $69,000 and Ethereum above $2,000.
Weaker-than-expected US retail sales and US Treasury bond buyback plans boosted risk assets like cryptocurrencies by easing aggressive Fed tightening fears.
The SEC proposed a new 'Regulation Crypto Assets' framework intended to provide clear rules for investment contracts involving crypto assets.
VanEck researchers suggested Bitcoin's nearly 11-month correction may be finishing as multiple capitulation signals indicate an accumulation phase.
